description: This file defines a module that exposes functions from torch._C._VariableFunctions as torch._VF, making them accessible without mypy type checking. It also includes a custom module class VFModule that forwards attribute access to torch._C._VariableFunctions and replaces the current module in sys.modules with an instance of VFModule.

classes.name: VFModule
classes.description: A custom module class that forwards attribute access to torch._C._VariableFunctions and replaces itself in sys.modules.

methods.name: __init__(self, name: str)
methods.description: Initializes the VFModule instance by setting self.vf to torch._C._VariableFunctions.

methods.name: object __getattr__(self, name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute from self.vf, forwarding attribute access.
